Welcome to the website of the **Fish Tool Use project**! This project focuses on anvil use in fish, an understudied example of tool use. 

📢 Follow the project updates on this website and on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/fishtooluse/){target="_blank"}.

📹 What is anvil use? Watch the video below, and find more explanation about it on the [Report your observation](report.qmd) and [Project](project.qmd) webpages.

📝 **How do I report an observation of fish anvil use?** Check the [Report your observation](report.qmd) webpage. You might be the first person to discover that this fish species is able to use tools! 

🤝 Who has already shared their observations of fish anvil use? Check the [contributors](contributors.qmd) webpage. 

👤 Who is leading and funding the Fish Tool Use project? Check the [investigators](investigators.qmd) webpage. 

ℹ️ What is this project all about? Check the [project](project.qmd) webpage. 

🤯 But wait a minute... fish can use tools? Check out the [Tool use in animals](tooluse.qmd) webpage to learn more about tool use in animals.

✉️ Feel free to contact me at juliette.tarieladam@gmail.com with any questions, comments, or observations.
